title: Local construction of the split determinant comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C$ be a short complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $r_2=r_1+r_3$ with $A,C$ finite locally free of ranks $r_1,r_3$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Let $U\subseteq X$ and $e:B|_U\simeq A|_U\oplus C|_U$ satisfy $e f|_U=\mathrm{inl}$ and $\mathrm{pr}_2 e=g|_U$. For every $W\subseteq U$ suppose a function $l_W:C(W)\to B(W)$ is supplied with $g_W l_W=\mathrm{id}$; it need not be additive or commute with restriction. Then each $x\in U$ has a neighborhood $V\subseteq U$ and, for every $W\subseteq V$, an $\mathcal O_X(W)$-linear equivalence $d_W:(\bigwedge^{r_1}A\otimes\bigwedge^{r_3}C)(W)\simeq(\bigwedge^{r_2}B)(W)$, where exterior powers are the sheafifications of [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. For every pair of tuples $a\in A(W)^{r_1}$ and $b\in C(W)^{r_3}$, $d_W((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge b_j))=\bigwedge(f(a_i),l_W(b_j))$, in this order, reindexed by $r_2=r_1+r_3$. The equivalences commute with restriction from $W$ to every $Z\subseteq W$. No proposed morphism $\varphi$ is part of this statement, and it asserts no comparison with such a morphism and no gluing between different neighborhoods V.

proof.text: Construct the unique natural linear family d₀ on U and retain both its wedge formula and its restriction compatibility.

Choose a common chart V containing x on which each given linear map is bijective. Convert these same maps to equivalences using LinearEquiv.ofBijective; their forward functions and wedge formulas are unchanged.
Apply the corrected restriction theorem to d and the restriction of d₀ to V. Its naturality is the retained hn, and the pointwise equality is definitional.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_split_comparison_exists {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] [S.X₃.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₃]
    (U : X.Opens)
    (e : S.X₂.restrict U.ι ≅ S.X₁.restrict U.ι ⊞ S.X₃.restrict U.ι)
    (hf : (restrictFunctor U.ι).map S.f ≫ e.hom = biprod.inl)
    (hg : e.hom ≫ biprod.snd = (restrictFunctor U.ι).map S.g)
    (l : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U → S.X₃.val.obj (op W) → S.X₂.val.obj (op W))
    (hl : ∀ W hW b, S.g.val.app (op W) (l W hW b) = b) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧
      ∃ (d : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ V →
        (exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.obj (op W)
          ≃ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.obj (op W)),
      (∀ W hW (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op W))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op W)),
        d W hW (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ W a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ W b)) =
        exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ W
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op W) (a j))
            (fun j ↦ l W (hW.trans hVU) (b j)) (Fin.cast hr i))) ∧
      (∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V) (hZW : Z ≤ W) y,
        (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (d W hW y) =
          d Z (hZW.trans hW)
            ((exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.map
              (homOfLE hZW).op y))
